fun_facts: Myles Price was born in Dallas, Texas.
Myles Price played college football at Texas Tech before Indiana.
When the Vikings called in spring 2025 to sign Myles Price as an undrafted free agent, he was sitting in his bathroom at home in Dallas.
In 2025, Myles Price returned 57 kickoffs for 1,479 yards, averaging 25.9 yards per return.
In 2026, Myles Price’s punt-return stats included an 86-yard long return and one punt-return touchdown.

basis.reasoning: The Pro-Football-Reference profile lists Texas Tech followed by Indiana, and ESPN identifies Indiana as Myles Price’s college. Together, they support Indiana as the last college listed.
